title: Cardano Academy: YouTube Blockchain Education in Amharic

ms.promise:
・Completed research and detailed content outline for the channel.
・Created branding materials (logo, channel banner, intro/outro animations).
・YouTube channel setup with descriptions, tags, and SEO optimization.
・Creation and upload of 3-5 pilot educational videos on blockchain basics and Cardano fundamentals.
・Community feedback gathered after the launch of pilot videos.
ms.criteria:
・Research results are documented with sources.
・The content outline includes at least 10 video topics with a defined content calendar for the first 3 months.
・Branding materials are visible on the YouTube channel.
・The YouTube channel is live, optimized with relevant keywords and tags.
・Each pilot video is 5-10 minutes long, covers a specific topic, and is presented in Amharic.
・Videos are uploaded to the channel, and the community is notified (via social media).
・At least 50 views and 5 comments/feedback pieces per video within the first month.
